quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 11,629,367,290.81, up 28.77% year over year; cost of sales RMB 7,765,934,717.93, up 34.83% on higher product costs; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,856,778,938.24, up 33.30%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,417,800,485.07, up 12.50%. Non-recurring items totalled RMB 438,978,453.17, mainly a fair-value gain of RMB 594,820,131.07 on placement shares held. Operating cash flow RMB 2,911,175,283.00, up 144.61% on higher sales collections. Inventory rose to RMB 5,889,639,980.56 from RMB 3,162,360,350.96 at end-2025 (raw materials RMB 2,501,790,222.00).

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: in ASIC compute chips, cooperation with the relevant customers is progressing smoothly; the company participates deeply in joint product development and some related PCB products have reached mass production. It is also expanding domestic Chinese compute business, where high-end product revenue is growing steadily. Multiple high-end products for AI compute, data centers, high-performance computing and optical modules are in large-scale mass production and the high-end product share keeps rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: facing tight raw-material supply and frequent price swings in H1 2026, the company negotiated product pricing with customers to pass through raw-material costs and says supply from its main raw-material suppliers is stable, with purchasing channels open and inventories reasonable.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: construction in progress RMB 5,223,332,183.80 at 30 June 2026 (RMB 3,609,874,903.28 at end-2025); fixed assets RMB 11,844,099,528.53, up mainly on equipment purchases. Plant Nine was transferred to fixed assets (90.25% of its RMB 274,971,900.00 budget); Plant Ten (budget RMB 1,303,302,870.30) is 78.97% invested and Plant Eleven (budget RMB 1,386,845,338.10) 31.27%, both under construction; the MFS Y assembly plant phase II is 57.89% invested and the Thailand plant and dormitory (budget RMB 1,537,810,649.95) 16.34%. In February 2026 the company acquired a Malaysian company to further expand its overseas production base; the report lists Sunpower Malaysia Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. as a subsidiary obtained in the period by asset acquisition.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 359,165,219.16, up 1.81%; more than 2000 R&D staff, 383 valid PCB patents (194 invention patents) and 95 ongoing R&D projects.
